title: The Surcharge of the Cloudstep Bazaar
story: High on the floating planks of the Cloudstep Bazaar, Mr 6 needs balloon-silk to patch the rescue balloon that carries the lamplighter children home. Tarnisque the Updraft Factor, a puffed-up wind-spirit with a ledger for a face, sells silk at 18.50 gold crowns a bolt — and smirks that every sale carries a 25% 'windage surcharge.' Mr 6 needs 4 bolts, but he also carries a rescuer's token worth 15 crowns off the final bill.
question: If Mr 6 buys 4 bolts, the 25% surcharge is added to that cost, and then the 15-crown token is taken off, how many gold crowns does he pay?
solution: The rescuer's token comes off last: 92.50 − 15 = 77.50 gold crowns.
praise: Working the surcharge as a percent was exactly right — the token just had to come off after the 25%, not before.
hint: Find the price of 4 bolts first, then grow it by 25%, and only then use the token.
victory: Mr 6 counted out 77.50 crowns exactly, and Tarnisque deflated like a sat-on cushion. The balloon flew home patched, and the lamplighter kids waved down at a very smug little six.
imagePrompt: A brave numeral-six knight in a blue cape haggling on a plank bazaar floating among sunset clouds, facing a puffed-up wind-spirit merchant made of swirling vapor and ledger pages, bolts of shimmering balloon-silk stacked nearby.
